points.text: No models trained or measured; ML contribution not demonstrated.
Dataset documentation incomplete: counts, licence, hosting, versioning, datasheet.
Toolkit and standardization framing overstated; only recommendations provided.
'Democratizing' framing conflicts with 2.2 TB collection size.
'14 snapshots' inconsistent with 15 cases in Table 1.
Typos.
No experiment trains baselines or computes proposed metrics.
Realistic correlated sampling asserted; not compared with real load data or uncorrelated sampling.
Random shuffle split risks leakage for interpolated time-series data.
No per-case sample counts, split sizes or feasibility rates.
Label quality unreported: solver tolerances, local AC optima, primal-dual gaps.
Keeping only samples feasible for all formulations may bias toward easy inputs.
Evaluation metrics described only in prose; no formulas or reference implementation.
14 snapshots stated versus 15 cases listed.
Equation reference error and typos.
Only load varies and costs are linear; far from real market-clearing problems.
Rank-one demand correlation not calibrated to observed load data.
No operational acceptability thresholds or intended-use discussion.
Local AC-OPF solutions treated as ground truth despite possible local optima.
Novelty over OPFData modest.
Realism of correlated sampling not shown versus OPFData.
Realistic time-series claim overstated; spline interpolation adds no sub-hourly variability.
Related work omits ML-for-OPF methods the benchmark targets.
Duplicate and misattributed citations.
'First/unique' positioning is an unfalsifiable conjunction of qualifiers.
Realistic sampling never compared with real data or prior sampling downstream.
Fair comparison and standardizing claims lack benchmark results.
Random shuffle of interpolated samples risks leakage.
Label quality: local AC optima, unreported tolerances and gaps.
'Realistic time-series' claim for synthetic interpolated data overstated.
'First' claim an unfalsifiable conjunction.
Retaining only all-formulation-feasible samples may bias the set.
14 snapshots versus 15 rows.
Open-source solver claim conflicts with MA27/HSL licensing.
Duplicate Jabr citation entry.
'Democratizing' framing ignores 2.2 TB size and generation cost.
Only releases data; no scientific or methodological contribution for ICLR.
Paper needs polishing.
Demand sampling marginal; status and time-series sampling repeat prior work.
Single global scale factor gives unrealistic linear demand correlation; variability unconvincing.
Dataset introduction only; no technical advances.
Variability ignores network structure changes, topology and contingencies; limits applicability.
OPF-only focus too narrow for general ML audience; generalization unclear.
Data still synthetic.
No ML-OPF benchmark results reported on the dataset.
Limited intellectual merit; no new insights on ML for physical systems.
Poor venue fit; impact limited to narrow ML+OPF community.

P.summary: No benchmark experiments or baseline results.
Dataset documentation and composition statistics missing.
Evaluation toolkit overstated; metrics only prose.
'Democratizing' framing vs dataset size and cost.
Realism of demand sampling unsubstantiated and uncalibrated.
Label quality and local optima unreported.

Q.summary: Sampling methods marginal or repeat prior work.
